description: This file contains a C# class implementing a test grain for Orleans, including methods for setting a target object, executing various test paths, and stress testing with serial and parallel tasks.

classes.name: ClientAddressableTestGrain
classes.description: A test grain class for Orleans that implements IClientAddressableTestGrain, providing methods for testing message paths and stress testing.

methods.name: SetTarget
methods.description: Sets the target object for the grain to interact with during tests.

methods.name: HappyPath
methods.description: Invokes the OnHappyPath method on the target with the provided message.

methods.name: SadPath
methods.description: Invokes the OnSadPath method on the target with the provided message.

methods.name: MicroSerialStressTest
methods.description: Performs a serial stress test by calling OnSerialStress repeatedly and asserting the expected result.

methods.name: MicroParallelStressTest
methods.description: Performs a parallel stress test by launching multiple tasks calling OnParallelStress and asserting their results.
